text:
elaine: Heads-up: sample-react chat shows scrambled SSE chunks after quick disconnect/reconnect. Parts arrive out of order in the UI.
tom: repro steps?
elaine: throttle network to offline ~200ms then back. UI sometimes renders part 4 before 3.
tom: typical culprit is buffering at a proxy or race between old/new connections. Any seq ids in the data?
elaine: payloads include part numbers but still out-of-order. curl test: `curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.dev/v1/stream?model=chat-lite&session=abc"` kill and rerun quickly shows repeated `data:` lines.
tom: options: 1) server emits monotonically increasing `seq` with every SSE data. 2) server emits `event: block_end id:<n>` per logical message. 3) client supports `Last-Event-ID` resume.
elaine: can SDK do anything short-term?
tom: yes — add `dedupe` + `reorder` in SDK: buffer out-of-order chunks up to `maxReorderMs` (configurable) and drop duplicates by seq. Also document using AbortController to close streams before reconnect.
infra-bot: infra note: adjusting proxy buffer window tonight; canary at 2026-04-03T02:00Z.
elaine: good. Also saw 401 on reconnect when token rotated which made duplicate chunks more likely.
tom: idea: include a `resume_token` in the first SSE payload so reconnections can use it instead of full auth to continue. Would need server retention of session state.
elaine: I'll update sample-app README with curl repro and the small JS snippet for dedupe/reorder.
tom: I'll open a tiny JS SDK PR exposing `maxReorderMs` and defaulting `dedupe=true` for sample apps. Add a `stream.reorder` metric to track incidence.
devex-bot: reminder: please link PRs in this thread; pinned until resolved.
elaine: thanks — will post links when PRs are up. :thumbsup:
